main_body: traditional Japanese two-story shop/machiya building with tiled roof
top_band: blue-grey roof ridge and tiled slope from row 1 to row 30 ( plus lower eave roof rows 41-46)
evidence: Rows 1-30 show the foreshortened top slope and ridge of the tiled roof with vertical tile rows, ending at a lighter front eave edge at row 29-30 and a dark eave shadow at rows 31-32 above the second-story plaster wall (rows 33-40), a lower tiled eave roof (rows 41-46), and the ground-floor wooden lattice facade and recessed doorway with noren curtain (rows 48-78).

style.evidence: The candidate has 5-6 distinct shading tones on the blue-grey roof tiles, plaster wall, wood lattice, and bamboo fenders. Individual tiles have per-tile highlights and shadows, plaster has subtle grain, and wood beams and noren curtains are shaded with dark material tones rather than flat fills.
